#
# `add_subdirectory("xpacks/@{{packageScope}}/{{packageName}}")`
#
# The result is an interface library that can be added to the linker with:
#
# `target_link_libraries(your-target PUBLIC {{packageScope}}::{{packageName}})`

# https://cmake.org/cmake/help/v3.20/
cmake_minimum_required (VERSION 3.20)

project (
  {{packageScope}}-{{packageName}}
  DESCRIPTION "{{descriptiveName}}"
  LANGUAGES CXX
)

# To access the optional functions, include the
# `cmake/{{packageScope}}-build-helper.cmake` file from the
# `@{{packageScope}}/build-helper` package.

if (COMMAND xpack_get_package_name_and_version)
  xpack_get_package_name_and_version (
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/package.json"
  )
  message (VERBOSE
           "Processing xPack ${PACKAGE_JSON_NAME}@${PACKAGE_JSON_VERSION}..."
  )
endif ()

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# The interface library is the main target of this package, which consumers
# (like embedded applications) link against. It defines the public API and
# properties of the library, and compiles the sources that are part of the
# public API.

# https://cmake.org/cmake/help/v3.20/command/add_library.html?highlight=interface#normal-libraries
# Visibility keywords: PRIVATE applies to the target itself; INTERFACE passes
# properties up to targets that link against it; PUBLIC does both.
add_library ({{packageScope}}-{{packageName}}-interface INTERFACE)

target_include_directories (
  {{packageScope}}-{{packageName}}-interface 
  INTERFACE{% for path in compilerIncludeFolders %}{% if forloop.first %} {% else %}
            {% endif %}"{{path | slice: 3, 999}}"{% endfor %}
)

target_sources (
  {{packageScope}}-{{packageName}}-interface
  INTERFACE{% for path in compilerSourceFiles %}{% if forloop.first %} {% else %}
            {% endif %}"{{path | slice: 3, 999}}"{% endfor %}
)

target_compile_definitions ({{packageScope}}-{{packageName}}-interface INTERFACE)

target_compile_options ({{packageScope}}-{{packageName}}-interface INTERFACE)

target_link_libraries (
  {{packageScope}}-{{packageName}}-interface INTERFACE {{packageScope}}::diag-trace
)

if (COMMAND xpack_display_target_lists)
  xpack_display_target_lists ({{packageScope}}-{{packageName}}-interface)
endif ()

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Extract the properties of the interface library to reuse them in the OBJECT
# and STATIC libraries, which are compiled before the platform library and need
# to get the same compile options.
get_property (
  {{packageScope}}-{{packageName}}-includes
  TARGET {{packageScope}}-{{packageName}}-interface
  PROPERTY INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES
)

get_property (
  {{packageScope}}-{{packageName}}-sources
  TARGET {{packageScope}}-{{packageName}}-interface
  PROPERTY INTERFACE_SOURCES
)

get_property (
  {{packageScope}}-{{packageName}}-compile-definitions
  TARGET {{packageScope}}-{{packageName}}-interface
  PROPERTY INTERFACE_COMPILE_DEFINITIONS
)

get_property (
  {{packageScope}}-{{packageName}}-compile-options
  TARGET {{packageScope}}-{{packageName}}-interface
  PROPERTY INTERFACE_COMPILE_OPTIONS
)

if (CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE STREQUAL "Debug")
  get_property (
    {{packageScope}}-diag-trace-includes
    TARGET {{packageScope}}::diag-trace
    PROPERTY INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES
  )
endif ()

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Optional OBJECT library: compiles the library sources once and shares the
# resulting object files across all test executables, rather than recompiling
# them per consumer.
#
# Include directories are managed explicitly instead of using PRIVATE linkage to
# the interface library. PRIVATE linkage would cause diag-trace's
# INTERFACE_SOURCES (trace.cpp) to be compiled into this OBJECT library via
# transitive propagation, which conflicts with the separate diag-trace
# compilation in each test executable. Consumers of this OBJECT library are
# expected to link separately to {{packageScope}}::diag-trace and to the
# platform-specific trace backend.
add_library ({{packageScope}}-{{packageName}}-objects OBJECT)

# Use PUBLIC so that the include directories are available both for the OBJECT
# library's own sources and for consumers of the library.
target_include_directories (
  {{packageScope}}-{{packageName}}-objects
  PUBLIC {% raw %}${{% endraw %}{{packageScope}}-{{packageName}}-includes}
)

# Use PRIVATE to avoid propagating the sources to consumers of the OBJECT
# library, which would cause duplicate symbol errors at link time.
target_sources (
  {{packageScope}}-{{packageName}}-objects
  PRIVATE {% raw %}${{% endraw %}{{packageScope}}-{{packageName}}-sources}
)

# Use PRIVATE to avoid propagating compile definitions to consumers of the
# OBJECT library.
target_compile_definitions (
  {{packageScope}}-{{packageName}}-objects
  PRIVATE {% raw %}${{% endraw %}{{packageScope}}-{{packageName}}-compile-definitions}
)

# Use PRIVATE to avoid propagating the compile options to consumers of the
# OBJECT library, which may cause conflicts with consumer-specific compile
# options.
target_compile_options (
  {{packageScope}}-{{packageName}}-objects
  PRIVATE {% raw %}${{% endraw %}{{packageScope}}-{{packageName}}-compile-options}
)

# Add the diag-trace include path in Debug without linking the diag-trace
# target: linking it would add trace.cpp as an INTERFACE_SOURCE and compile it
# into the OBJECT library, causing duplicate symbols at link time.
if (CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE STREQUAL "Debug")
  target_include_directories (
    {{packageScope}}-{{packageName}}-objects
    PRIVATE {% raw %}${{% endraw %}{{packageScope}}-diag-trace-includes}
  )
endif ()

if (COMMAND xpack_display_target_lists)
  xpack_display_target_lists ({{packageScope}}-{{packageName}}-objects)
endif ()

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# library's own sources and for consumers of the library.
target_include_directories (

  {{packageScope}}-{{packageName}}-static
  PRIVATE {% raw %}${{% endraw %}{{packageScope}}-{{packageName}}-sources}
)

# STATIC library.
target_compile_definitions (
  {{packageScope}}-{{packageName}}-static
  PRIVATE {% raw %}${{% endraw %}{{packageScope}}-{{packageName}}-compile-definitions}
)

# Use PRIVATE to avoid propagating the compile options to consumers of the
# STATIC library, which may cause conflicts with consumer-specific compile
# options.
target_compile_options (
  {{packageScope}}-{{packageName}}-static
  PRIVATE {% raw %}${{% endraw %}{{packageScope}}-{{packageName}}-compile-options}

# Add the diag-trace include path in Debug without linking the diag-trace

  )

# Aliases.
# https://cmake.org/cmake/help/v3.20/command/add_library.html#alias-libraries
add_library (
  {{packageScope}}::{{packageName}} ALIAS {{packageScope}}-{{packageName}}-interface
)

  VERBOSE
  "> {{packageScope}}::{{packageName}} -> {{packageScope}}-{{packageName}}-interface"
)
